data.long_meaning: The name Eshaya is recorded with the meaning “Goddess of prosperity”. Eshaya is a Sanskrit name meaning “Goddess of prosperity”. in_marathi.name: Eshaya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eshaya is the divine goddess of prosperity and success. She is a form of the goddess Mahalakshmi, who is revered for her blessings of wealth, abundance, and good fortune.
